text_block_list.text:
During lunch break. As I finished eating 
and was clearing away the dishes—
Bono~...! Let me take a breather...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I just finished cooking, so you're all 
good! Did something happen~?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Well, my leg cramped up. Seems like 
that's been happening a lot lately.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Hmm, hmm... Well then—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Ta-da♪ Dig in to this~!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Whoa! What is this? It looks delicious!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
It's 'Simmered Komatsuna and Thick Fried 
Tofu'! Both are packed full of calcium♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
You aren't a big fan of milk, right, 
Biko-chan? Cramping easily might be due to 
a lack of calcium. So eat this up and get 
fully replenished♪

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Ooooh...! Thanks, Bono! Down the hatch!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Thanks, Akebono-chan. I was just 
getting so hungry...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Then, then, how about trying this for 
dessert?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
A 'Banana Rice-Flour Pound Cake'! It's 
super nutritious, and it'll keep you full 
for a long time~!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Pound cake... super, nutritious...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: This is exactly what I needed~!!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
That's incredible! How did you know right 
away what I wanted?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I noticed the toughness bars were sold out 
at the school store. You're heading out to 
run right after your part-time shift, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Eating this should recharge your energy 
instantly! Do your best~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Heh, so this is the rumored... 'Bono 
Diner', huh? Heard you listen to people's 
troubles.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
! 'Bono Diner', huh! Yup yup, in response 
to the rumors, we are open for business!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Welcome♪ What kind of trouble are you 
dealing with, Hishi-ama-san~?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Well, I've run into a bit of a pickle—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Word is going around that there's a ghost 
in the dorm... Windows opening on their 
own, weird noises... urgh!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's scared out of their minds, so 
I've been doing patrols to handle it, but—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Y-You can't have a one-on-one duel with a 
ghost, can ya?! You can't see 'em... so I 
can't even lay a finger on it...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
...Well, guess that's obviously not 
something you can solve. For today, just 
gimme whatever to fill my belly—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I've got a solution for that!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: You do?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Yup, Operation 'Salt-Grilled Sea Bream'~! 
If you eat this, you'll definitely beat 
any ghost!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
H-Huh? ...Well, since you made it for me, 
down the hatch.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Mmm... Mmmnngh!! This is amazing!! It 
feels like power is surging right through 
me...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
You're giving it your all every day, so 
you're exhausted, right? The sea bream's 
nutrition and salt will wipe that fatigue 
right away!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Plus, since ancient times, sea bream has 
been known as an 'evil-warding' food♪ With 
this, ghosts won't stand a chance!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I see... Yeah... YEAH!! Somehow, I really 
feel like I can take it down now!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, ghosts don't scare me! With this 
fighting spirit, I'm gonna blow 'em away!
